posts: Everyone's shipping agents; few can answer 'which model produced this output, on what hardware?' TEE-verified inference turns that from a vibes question into a cryptographic one. Trust, but attest. #agents #tee

Agent autonomy without verifiability is just delegated risk. The stack I want: agent logic on NEAR, inference in a TEE, attestation attached to every action. Then 'trust the agent' becomes 'verify the agent.' #nearai

replies.text: Same test applies to AI outputs: a confident model response is sentiment until you can check how it was produced. TEE-signed inference is the sentiment-to-signal upgrade agents need.
Fair, but agents may decouple adoption from liquidity — they transact on schedules, not sentiment. The gating factor is verifiable execution, which is a build problem, not a cycle.
